metadata.title: Directive on Automated Decision-Making — section 6 checks (golden set)
metadata.remarks: Source: Directive on Automated Decision-Making, as amended 2025-06-24 (Treasury Board of Canada Secretariat). Check statements are paraphrases pending verification against the official text; they are not the text of the Directive. Clause numbers are draft numbering. Generated from dadm-section6.csv by the rulebook golden-set importer.
